thread:
carlos: quick sketch - i'd like a compact "prefetch lease" primitive on the gateway so clients can ask the edge to warm an upstream replica or node-local cache before sending a short request. reduces cold p99 for fast reads.
mei: sounds good. immediate concerns: safety (no accidental writes), hedging interaction, and abuse surface.
anu: agree. safety rule: prefetch intents are safe-only by default (GET/HEAD). for non-safe methods require an explicit Idempotency-Key and route opt-in. prefetch must never trigger irreversible side-effects.
greg: wire idea: client -> gateway with `x-rw-prefetch: intent; x-rw-prefetch-mode: conn,kv` -> gateway responds `103 Prefetch-Lease: id=lease42; ttl=450` while it warms. real request sends `x-rw-lease-id: lease42`. upstream can verify lease and optionally materialize warmed state. treat as a hint if not present.
mei: hedging notes: if client hedges multiple concurrent attempts and multiple prefetches race, the lease binding decides which attempt owns warmed state. rule: earliest lease creation timestamp wins; other attempts receive `x-rw-prefetch-status: ignored` or `joined`. document tie-breaker.
anu: anti-abuse: per-tenant token-bucket + route-level concurrency cap. adaptive controller reduces acceptance when hit-rate low or upstream load high. emit `prefetch.reject_reason` (quota|circuit|adaptive).
greg: header examples: `x-rw-prefetch: 1
x-rw-prefetch-mode: kv
x-rw-lease-ttl-ms: 450
x-rw-lease-id: lease42`
mei: security: sign leases (lease-sig) so upstream can verify provenance; strip prefetch headers for untrusted external traffic. use mTLS/internal ACLs for validation.
carlos: streaming endpoints: if prewarm applied before stream open, include initial metadata `prefetch-status: applied`; if applied mid-stream emit trailer `prefetch-result: applied|ignored;cost_ms=..`. lets clients adapt early reads.
anu: billing: Hosted treat prefetch non-billable initially; Dedicated offer opt-in billing flag. provide metric labels per-tenant so we can later charge if needed.
telemetry-bot: canary report: prefetch-lease-probe rolled to 10% on /fast-path. cold p95 down 105ms, upstream conns +8% during lease windows, prefetch_rejects 1.9%.
mei: action items: carlos to draft RFC with header list + lease signing, anu to write idempotency/safety rules, greg to model amplification and default quotas, infra to add telemetry dashboard. schedule follow-up next Tue.
carlos: RFC draft name: "gateway prefetch lease primitive (safety & hedging)". i'll post by EOW.
telemetry-bot: RFC created: https://rfc.internal/r/7801-gateway-prefetch-lease-safety
